entities.summary: Jacques Loew was a French Dominican friar and priest, who founded both the Mission ouvrière Saints-Pierre-et-Paul and – with René Voillaume – the School of the Faith in Fribourg, Switzerland. He is best known for starting the worker-priest movement.
